sentences.text:
Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
03.10.2024 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Sl. No.30 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 akd
 [Adjourned]
 C. R. R. 3546 of 2024
 In Re: Sangita Samanta & Anr.
 ... ... Petitioners
 1.
Petitioners contend petitioner no.1 was driven out of her matrimonial home with a one year old child.

Criminal case under Sections 498A/406 IPC as well as proceeding under Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act has been registered and pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Katwa.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In retaliation, opposite party no.1 i.e. father-in-law of petitioner no.1 has filed a criminal case in Asansol.
Petitioners pray for transfer of the said proceeding.

2. Let a copy of the petition be served upon opposite party no.1 through Registered Speed Post with Acknowledgment Due and opposite party no.2-State through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and file affidavit-of-service on the next date of hearing.
3. Let the matter appear as 'Contested Application' four weeks after ensuing Puja Vacation.
4.

There shall be stay of the impugned proceeding being Complaint Case No. 109 of 2024 pending before the learned 2nd Judicial Magistrate, Asansol for a period of six weeks after ensuing Puja Vacation or until further orders, whichever is earlier, so far as the petitioner is concerned.
5. Liberty is given to the parties to apply for extension and/or modification and/or variation of this order upon notice to the other side.
6. Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the petitioners on usual undertaking.

(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
